statistics.oracle_scope: Retrospective opportunity conditional on observed20 combinations and the same development question; source-generation oracle choices use that question outcome
statistics.ci_scope: Question-cluster resampling retaining all generation repeats together; task and BBH subtask stratification; conditional on fixed calibration100 routes, frozen model/operator and observed generations
statistics.multiple_comparison_scope: Descriptive paired intervals; no multiplicity-adjusted mechanism claim

hardware_scope.generation42_versus_other_generations: Both member sampling seed and execution platform change. Their individual effects are unidentified in this S1 comparison.
hardware_scope.generation137_versus2024: These two member generations share the A6000 hardware class and matched library versions, supporting a within-platform generation comparison. Bitwise reproducibility remains a separate question.
hardware_scope.strong_generation42: Calibration100 uses 300 new A6000 samples. Diagnostic200 uses 600 historical Windows-host samples. Costs and hardware provenance stay separate.
hardware_scope.typed_aggregation: All 19200 typed aggregation attempts bind A6000 scope evidence. Upstream member hardware provenance remains attached.

publication_boundary: All original statistical fields copied without selection; raw source references, per-question output arrays, questions and gold excluded.
